messages.content: Help me find service provider who provide cleaning service.

function.name: get_service_id

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the quantity of service, expressed as the number of service sessions or instances.

message.content: Sure! To help you find a cleaning service provider, I’ll need to identify the correct service ID for cleaning. Could you confirm which service ID corresponds to cleaning in your system? If you’re unsure, I can try to retrieve it for you.
